headline: Proposed revisions to Student Discipline and Due Process policy 520 and the Student Code of Conduct.
summary: Proposed revisions to Students 520 cover policy numbers, intervention plan language, and the gun possession rule for long-term suspension. Proposed revisions to the Student Code of Conduct cover policy numbers, wording, and behavior tables.
items: Public forum, with up to three minutes per speaker
Presentation on proposed revisions to Students 520: Discipline and Due Process, by Stacy Champey, Executive Director of Safe and Supportive Schools
Presentation on proposed revisions to the Student Code of Conduct, by Stacy Champey, Executive Director of Safe and Supportive Schools
location: SAU District Office, 20 Hecker Street, Large Conference Room

AGENDA 
 
MANCHESTER SCHOOL DISTRICT SAU #37 
POLICY COMMITTEE  
 
September 16, 2026 5:30 p.m. Or Immediately following  
Committee Members Want, O’Neil-Wong, Potter, St. John 
and Taylor 
Student Conduct 
Aldermanic Chambers 
Student Member:  Wadd Mohamed (WHS) and Julie 
Langlois (WHS) 
City Hall (3rd Floor) 
 
 
1. Chair Want calls the meeting to order.  
 
2. The Clerk calls the roll.  
 
3. Public Forum 
 
4. Chairwoman Want advises the purpose of the public forum is to give the residents of Manchester 
the opportunity to address the board.  All people wishing to speak will have up to three (3) 
minutes to do so, and any comments must be directed to the chair.  Any resident wishing to 
speak will come forward to the nearest microphone, clearly state their name and address when 
recognized and give their comments. 
 
5. Chair Want advises that if there is no one else present to speak and there are no other public 
comments that have been submitted, a motion would be in order to take all comments under 
advisement and to further receive and file any written documentation presented.  
 
 
6. Approval of the Minutes from the August 19, 2026 Policy Committee meeting. 
 
 
7. Presentations
